title: GPT-5.6 used a prompt to close a 30-year gap in convex optimization
summary: An AI model was used to address a 30-year-old mathematical gap in convex optimization theory, specifically related to CDC (Convex Dive Complexity) proof, demonstrating AI's emerging capability to contribute to fundamental mathematical research and solve longstanding theoretical problems.
problem_solved: Bridging a 30-year unresolved gap in convex optimization theory related to CDC proof complexity.
why_valuable: Demonstrates AI's potential to contribute to pure mathematical research and solve longstanding open problems in theoretical computer science, opening new avenues for human-AI collaboration in mathematical discovery.
